name: Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on a monitoring framework for resilient European forests
part_text:
The European Parliament has rejected the Commission's plan for a new EU-wide system to monitor the health of Europe's forests. Instead of amending it, Parliament asks the Commission to withdraw the proposal entirely. So no new forest monitoring rules come out of this report. Parliament's position is that the plan should be dropped, not changed.

- What changes: nothing yet. Parliament rejects the forest monitoring plan and asks for it to be withdrawn.
- Who it affects: forest owners, forest industries, and EU and national bodies that would have gathered forest data.
- What happens next: the Commission is asked to withdraw its proposal; talks with EU governments cannot proceed on this text.
